name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold development company focused on advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos Project located in the provinces of Salta and Catamarca, Argentina. The project received key environmental approval from Salta authorities in 2026 and was formally approved for inclusion under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI). The company is in the development stage, working toward feasibility and permitting on one of Argentina's most significant silver-gold deposits.
